pages.text: Move like your life depends on it. Footwork adds dodging, strafing, and positional combat mechanics that reward you for moving in every fight.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Footwork is available from T1 and changes how every fight plays. A dodge roll costs stamina and has a cooldown, so positioning and timing matter.$(br2)$(bold)Class synergy:$() The Ranger and Samurai get the most out of Footwork's mobility. The Berserker and Vanguard can use it defensively, to close gaps or disengage.
$(bold)Reference:$() Each Footwork move is described in its item tooltip, and JEI lists the mechanics.$(br2)$(bold)Next: practice the dodge roll on a zombie before you need it on a boss.$()
